subject: general
question: In how many years does a sum of ₹10,000 yield the simple interest of ₹1600 at the rate of 8% per annum?
solution:
Given:

Principal (P) = Rs.10,000

Simple Interest (SI) = Rs.1600

Rate of interest (R) = 8% per annum

Formula Used:

Simple Interest = (P × R × T) / 100

Calculation:

Let the time be T years.

Using the formula:

Simple Interest = (P × R × T) / 100

1600 = (10000 × 8 × T) / 100

⇒ 1600 = 800T

⇒ T = 1600 / 800

⇒ T = 2 years

The time required is 2 years.

Option 1 is the correct answer.
